title: SSTI runner: detect Server-Side Template Injection in Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, and similar template engines
goal: Server-Side Template Injection is not detected by ZAP or Nuclei by default and is absent from AegisPT's toolkit. SSTI leads directly to RCE and is in OWASP Top 10 (A03 - Injection). Gruyere uses a custom template language (GTL) that was exploited for code execution. Implement an ssti-probe runner: (1) Detection probes: inject mathematical expressions into all string parameters: {{7*7}}, ${7*7}, #{7*7}, <#assign x=7*7>${x}, {{7*'7'}}. If response contains '49' or '7777777' → SSTI confirmed for specific engine. (2) Engine fingerprinting: use different payloads to identify: Jinja2 (Python): {{config}} returns app config; Twig (PHP): {{_self.env.registerUndefinedFilterCallback}}; Freemarker (Java): ${7*7}; Smarty (PHP): {$smarty.version}; Velocity (Java): #set($x=7*7)$x. (3) Context-aware probing: test both reflected (parameters) and stored (form fields that render in templates) locations. (4) Gruyere GTL: the {{snippet}} template replacement in Gruyere — test for injection in custom template languages. (5) Findings: 'SSTI Confirmed (Engine: Jinja2) — Remote Code Execution Possible'. Severity Critical. Active tier. Tool: tplmap or custom payload list.
scope: Gruyere custom template language GTL was exploited for code execution. SSTI is not in AegisPT tooling. Tplmap tool automates SSTI detection and engine identification. High-value finding: SSTI → RCE.
generation_reason: Gruyere's GTL template injection + general SSTI absence from AegisPT tooling — mathematical expression injection is the standard detection approach, leads to Critical RCE findings.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Detection probes only — mathematical expression injection. DO NOT send OS command execution payloads in this task. Detection is confirmed by '49' response, not by actual command execution.
constraints.safety: SSTI payloads MUST be mathematical expressions only (7*7). No __import__, no config dumps beyond detection, no os.system payloads.

success_criteria: ssti-probe detects Jinja2/Twig/Freemarker via mathematical expression response.
NEVER sends OS command payloads — math expressions only.

acceptance_criteria: Detects Jinja2 SSTI on test target.
